While the patient has diabetes and is on atorvastatin, there is no documentation of weight-loss interventions attempted or their outcomes.

Please provide documentation of prior medical treatment attempts for obesity, including:
- Dates and duration of any supervised weight-loss program(s)

- Outcome/results of these interventions

Submit within 10 business days to avoid request denial.
